method: Read the full verification report and check-log, compared R and Julia test counts and runtimes with captured command output, and applied the naturalness protocol.
coverage: Complete report, exact saved draft version v2.
score_reason: The report uses specific test names, counts, runtimes, and explicit evidence limits.
confidence_reason: The report is short and test results are concrete, but this is an editorial self-judgment.

examples.quote: Completed a verification checkpoint on the current dirty `codex/general-sd-regression` worktree. No implementation files were changed in this checkpoint.
examples.cue: The opening states the verification scope and source-change boundary.
examples.impact: Readers can distinguish test evidence from implementation completion.

science_gate_reason: The report limits claims to the named targeted tests and explicitly excludes coverage calibration and broader capability claims.
facts_gate_reason: Assertion counts, runtimes, warnings, and test coverage descriptions were checked against the run outputs and inspected tests.
references_gate_reason: This test record contains no literature or external-source claims.
calibration_status: No held-out style controls were used; exact run outputs were checked.
